segments.t: Accept The Balance of Nature from Conservator Ilthalaine

tips.text: Young nightsabers and thistle boars wander all around the base of Aldrassil. Start killing as soon as you leave the conservator.

segments.t: Accept The Woodland Protector from Melithar Staghelm

tips.text: Melithar stands just north of Ilthalaine. The dryad is a short walk south-west.

segments.t: Complete The Balance of Nature: 7 Young Nightsaber, 4 Young Thistle Boar

tips.text: Loop around Aldrassil. Tag anything near you; the two mob types share the same ground.

segments.t: Turn in The Balance of Nature to Conservator Ilthalaine; Accept The Balance of Nature from Conservator Ilthalaine
Accept Simple Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine

tips.text: Your class letter. Hand it to your trainer inside Aldrassil for a little XP and your first spells.

segments.t: Accept Etched Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine
Accept Encrypted Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine
Accept Hallowed Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine
Accept Verdant Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine
Turn in The Woodland Protector to Tarindrella; Accept The Woodland Protector from Tarindrella; Accept Nature's Call from Tarindrella

tips.text: Nature's Call is a Forever quest: the Gnarlpine Totems sit in the same grell camp west of Aldrassil, so do both together.

segments.t: Turn in Simple Sigil to Alyissia
Turn in Etched Sigil to Ayanna Everstride
Turn in Encrypted Sigil to Frahun Shadewhisper
Turn in Hallowed Sigil to Shanda
Turn in Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak
Accept The Goddess Provides from Shanda

tips.text: Forever racial quest from Shanda: cast Elune's Light and Shadowmeld, then talk to her again.

segments.t: Turn in The Goddess Provides to Shanda
Train your level 2-4 spells inside Aldrassil

actions.label: Train your level 2-4 spells inside Aldrassil

segments.t: Optional: pick a gathering profession from the junior trainers around Aldrassil

tips.text: Forever adds junior Herbalism, Mining and Skinning trainers in the starting areas. They teach the first rank, so you can gather from level 1.
Herbalism pairs well with Teldrassil: Peacebloom and Silverleaf grow along every path here.

segments.t: Complete The Woodland Protector: 8 Fel Moss; Complete Nature's Call: 4 Gnarlpine Totem

tips.text: Grells drop the Fel Moss. Grab the totems on the ground between pulls.

segments.t: Turn in The Woodland Protector to Tarindrella; Turn in Nature's Call to Tarindrella
Accept Webwood Venom from Gilshalan Windwalker

tips.text: The Webwood spiders live up the slope north of Aldrassil, at the Shadowthread Cave.

segments.t: Accept A Good Friend from Dirania Silvershine

tips.text: Dirania stands on the east edge of Shadowglen.

segments.t: Complete The Balance of Nature: 7 Mangy Nightsaber, 7 Thistle Boar

tips.text: The Mangy Nightsabers and Thistle Boars roam north of Aldrassil, on the way to the spider cave.

segments.t: Turn in A Good Friend to Iverron; Accept A Friend in Need from Iverron

tips.text: Iverron lies poisoned at the mouth of the Shadowthread Cave.

segments.t: Complete Webwood Venom: 10 Webwood Venom Sac

tips.text: Stay near the cave entrance; the spiders outside respawn fast enough.

segments.t: Loot Fang of Githyiss and accept Fang of Githyiss

tips.text: Githyiss the Vile is a named spider just inside the cave. The fang starts a Forever quest worth 450 XP.
Speedrun: only if Githyiss is up when you pass; do not wait for a respawn.

segments.t: Back at Aldrassil: turn in Webwood Venom and accept Webwood Egg from Gilshalan
Turn in Fang of Githyiss to Gilshalan Windwalker
Turn in A Friend in Need to Dirania Silvershine; Accept Iverron's Antidote from Dirania Silvershine
Turn in The Balance of Nature to Conservator Ilthalaine
Complete Iverron's Antidote: 7 Hyacinth Mushroom, 4 Moonpetal Lily

tips.text: Hyacinth Mushrooms grow around the base of Aldrassil; the Moonpetal Lily is near the pool just north of it.

segments.t: Complete Webwood Egg: Webwood Egg

tips.text: The eggs are at the very back of the Shadowthread Cave. Kill spiders on the way for the Webwood Ichor.

segments.t: Complete Iverron's Antidote: Webwood Ichor

tips.text: Any Webwood Spider can drop the Ichor.

segments.t: Turn in Iverron's Antidote to Dirania Silvershine; Accept Iverron's Antidote from Dirania Silvershine

tips.text: The antidote is on a timer. Go straight to Iverron and skip the other turn-ins for now.
Speedrun: run back to Iverron right away, the timer is generous but the walk is long.

segments.t: Turn in Iverron's Antidote to Iverron
Turn in Webwood Egg to Gilshalan and accept Tenaron's Summons
Turn in Tenaron's Summons to Tenaron Stormgrip; Accept Crown of the Earth from Tenaron Stormgrip
Complete Crown of the Earth: Filled Crystal Phial

tips.text: The Shadowglen moonwell is a short walk north of Aldrassil.

segments.t: Turn in Crown of the Earth to Tenaron Stormgrip; Accept Crown of the Earth from Tenaron Stormgrip
Accept The Adventurer at the Lost Journal

tips.text: Forever Camping quest: read the Lost Journal near Tenaron. It sends you to Lyreena in Dolanaar.
Speedrun: worth it. The Camping chain gives over 1,000 XP for two minutes of walking inside Dolanaar.

segments.t: Accept In Favor of Elune from Shanda

tips.text: Priests: Shanda sends you to Laurna in Dolanaar for your next spell quest.

segments.t: Train your new spells before leaving Shadowglen

actions.label: Train your new spells before leaving Shadowglen

segments.t: Accept Dolanaar Delivery from Porthannius

tips.text: Porthannius waits on the road south out of Shadowglen. The delivery ends at the Dolanaar inn on your way.
